4) Post-mortem ticket created and exec alert if we cannot stabilize in 45 minutes.

Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 10:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [P0] Production latency + 502 spike — US-WEST-2 (we're seeing 30s tails) — RESOLVED

Summary and closure:
- Action taken: At 09:41 PT we initiated a 100% regional steer of Aurora Health production traffic from us-west-2 to us-east-1 (commands: routing.override.set(prefix=aurora-prod, preferred_region=us-east-1, weight=100)).
- Observed result: within 4 minutes 5xx rate fell from 5.2% -> 0.8%, p95 latency improved from 3.2s -> 0.95s, and tail spikes reduced — see attached latency-graphs-07-05.pdf.
- Side effects: Session-level cold starts led to a temporary uptick in support tickets for long-running sessions; Aurora ops queued an in-app banner and rotated sessions. No data loss.
- Post-action: We will keep the steer active for one hour and then run a slow drain back to us-west-2 while monitoring KPIs. Post-mortem ticket SRV-4432 created; owners: Hannah (ops) and Rishi (exec review).

Thanks for the quick coordination — recommend we schedule a 30-minute retrospective tomorrow to review root cause and whether an automated fallback could be safer for customer-facing sessions.

Attachments: latency-graphs-07-05.pdf

Regards,
Avery Johnson
